description: Tenzo connects ChatGPT to your restaurant data. Ask questions in plain English about sales, labour, covers, average check, item mix, customer reviews and manager logs across all your locations. The app reads the same metrics and dimensions you already see in your Tenzo dashboard, respects your existing user permissions and business access, and can save useful queries back as cards and dashboards in your Tenzo account.

defaultPrompt: Show me sales by day yesterday as a chart
Which locations were best and worst last week?
Tell me about my best employees
